pairs.en: Tuesday to Sunday, lunch 11:00–14:00 and dinner 17:00–20:30; closed on Monday.

pairs.zh: 禾巷小馆 · 街坊的午饭与晚饭
pairs.en: Hexiang Xiaoguan · Neighborhood Lunch and Dinner

pairs.zh: 禾巷小馆是一家社区家常菜馆，面向附近居民和午休用餐的上班族。厨房按午市与晚市备料，提供单人饭菜组合和适合分食的热菜，不经营酒吧或宴会厅。
pairs.en: Hexiang Xiaoguan is a neighborhood home-style restaurant for nearby residents and office workers on their lunch break. The kitchen prepares ingredients for lunch and dinner service, offering single-portion meal sets and hot dishes suited to sharing. We do not operate a bar or a banquet hall.

pairs.zh: 周二至周日营业，周一休息；14:00–17:00 不营业，午市与晚市分开。节假日营业安排待补充。
pairs.en: Open Tuesday to Sunday, closed Monday; closed 14:00–17:00, with lunch and dinner served separately. Holiday hours: To be provided.

pairs.zh: 午市 11:00–14:00 到店，按店内菜单当天标注的供应点单；一个人吃，点香菇鸡腿饭，或午市单人组合。厨房午市停止点菜时间为 13:30。
pairs.en: Come in during lunch, 11:00–14:00, and order from the items marked as available on the in-store menu that day. For one person, order the Braised Chicken Leg with Shiitake over Rice or the Lunch Single-Person Set. The kitchen's last lunch order time is 13:30.

pairs.zh: 晚市 17:00–20:30 到店，点番茄炖牛腩、时蔬豆腐煲，米饭单点，几样热菜一起分食。厨房晚市停止点菜时间为 20:00。
pairs.en: Come in during dinner, 17:00–20:30, and order the Tomato-Braised Beef Brisket and the Seasonal Vegetable and Tofu Clay Pot, with rice ordered separately, sharing several hot dishes together. The kitchen's last dinner order time is 20:00.

pairs.zh: 单点米饭 3 元/碗；香菇鸡腿饭与午市单人组合包含米饭，不再另收米饭费用；其他热菜米饭单点。
pairs.en: Rice ordered separately is CNY 3 per bowl; the Braised Chicken Leg with Shiitake over Rice and the Lunch Single-Person Set include rice at no extra charge; rice is ordered separately with other hot dishes.

pairs.zh: 堂食座位 24 个，以两人桌和四人桌为主；不设包间。座位数不代表实时空位，不能承诺随到随坐。儿童座椅数量、停车条件待补充。
pairs.en: 24 dine-in seats, mainly two-person and four-person tables; no private rooms. Seat count does not reflect real-time availability, and we cannot promise seating on arrival. Number of child seats and parking conditions: To be provided.

pairs.zh: 周二至周日营业，周一休息；14:00–17:00 不营业
pairs.en: Open Tuesday to Sunday, closed Monday; closed 14:00–17:00
The variety is not guaranteed to be the same every day.

pairs.zh: 单点米饭 3 元/碗，饮用水免费提供。
pairs.en: Rice ordered separately is 3 yuan/bowl; drinking water is provided free of charge.

pairs.zh: 已知菜品涉及小麦、大豆和菌菇，完整过敏原清单待补充。
pairs.en: The dishes listed involve wheat, soy and mushrooms; the full allergen list is to be provided.
